title: Gwynne Shotwell's special launch shoes at SpaceX

tellings.quote: Gwen Shotwell, who's the COO of SpaceX, who basically runs it at this point, she's like, I wear my special shoes, you

plain: Gwynne Shotwell, the chief operating officer of the rocket company SpaceX, whom Michels says basically runs it now, has said she wears her special shoes on launch days. Michels brings this up himself, crediting something called Countdown to Launch, as an example of how even hard-nosed engineers keep small rituals.
